name: Spice Village Ayurvedic Centre (Spice Village — CGH Earth)
tagline: Thekkady hill resort with a Green Leaf Ayurvedic centre for doctor-led Panchakarma
summary: CGH Earth’s Spice Village in Thekkady is an eco-resort set in spice gardens with a Green Leaf–certified Ayurvedic centre offering doctor-led Panchakarma and wellness programmes amid the Periyar high…
description: Spice Village is a CGH Earth eco-resort on Kumily–Thekkady Road set among spice gardens and modelled on the region’s tribal dwellings. The property houses a Green Leaf–certified Ayurveda centre that provides classical Ayurvedic therapies and wellness programmes.

The on-site Ayurvedic centre offers doctor consultations and traditional therapies (including Panchakarma sequences) integrated with the resort’s nature, yoga and food programmes — making it a practical base for therapeutic stays in the high ranges near Periyar.

Visitors get a mix of clinical-style, physician-supervised Ayurvedic care and resort comforts: guided nature walks, spice-plantation experiences, herbal tea sessions and easy access to Periyar activities such as bamboo rafting and treks.

For medical or long-form Panchakarma plans, the centre follows classical programmes but individual treatment length and medicines are determined after a physician consultation — confirm programme details directly with the centre before you travel.
highlights: Green Leaf–certified Ayurvedic centre operated within the CGH Earth Spice Village resort
Doctor-led Panchakarma and traditional therapies (personalised after consultation)
Set in spice gardens with nature walks, yoga and farm-to-table meals
Close to Periyar Wildlife area — adds easy access to treks, bamboo rafting and spice plantation visits
Resort combines clinical-style Ayurveda with eco-resort comforts and activities

sections.heading: Background
body: Spice Village is part of the CGH Earth group and markets itself as an eco-living resort close to the Periyar ranges in Thekkady. The property blends local architecture and environmental initiatives with hospitality and health services.
The resort lists an on-site, Green Leaf–certified Ayurveda centre that provides clinical-style, physician-supervised Ayurvedic therapies alongside the resort’s experiential offerings.

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: The Ayurveda centre offers consultations with resident vaidyas and traditional therapies; visitors commonly book Panchakarma courses or shorter therapeutic massages and treatments. Panchakarma is a classical, multi-step detox and rejuvenation protocol prescribed after a medical consultation—confirm exact packages, durations and medicines with the centre.

Away from treatments, guests can join spice-plantation walks, herbal tea sessions, guided nature walks, yoga classes and cultural evenings. The resort’s location makes it practical to plan Periyar wildlife activities (treks, bamboo rafting, boat safaris) as day excursions.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Book treatments and accommodation well in advance, and request a pre-arrival medical briefing if you plan multi-day Panchakarma. Classical Panchakarma courses are often 14 days or longer in many Ayurvedic centres; confirm the centre’s recommended duration for your condition.

Bring medical history, current medication lists and any required test reports for the Ayurveda physician. Ask the centre about seasonal herbal medicines, dietary arrangements during treatment and any travel restrictions linked to therapies (for example, rest and diet requirements after certain procedures).

visitorInfo.bestTime: September–March (cool, drier weather in the high ranges; comfortable for treks and outdoor activities)
visitorInfo.howToReach: By road from Kottayam/Kochi (approx. 190 km from Cochin International Airport) or from Madurai (approx. 145 km). Kumily/Thekkady bus station is a short drive from the resort; confirm transfers with the resort.
etiquette: Book Ayurveda consultations and Panchakarma programmes before arrival and allow time for pre-treatment medical checks.
Carry a summary of your medical history and current medications; share these with the resort’s doctor.
Expect programme-specific dietary and rest guidance during Panchakarma—follow the physician’s instructions and ask about post-treatment restrictions.
Confirm any travel, timing or COVID/health protocols with the resort before you travel.
